beats.say: Take India apart, and twelve of the world's fifty most populous countries would be Indian states.
beats.cap: India split into states: 12 of the world's top 50 by people (2026, projected)

beats.say: Bihar, in eastern India, is projected to have about as many people as Mexico.
But Mexico has about twenty times the land.
Maharashtra, in western India, is projected to outnumber Japan.
beats.cap: Maharashtra 129.6 M vs Japan 122.4 M (2026, projected)

beats.say: In twenty eleven, it was the other way round. Japan has been shrinking.
beats.cap: 1 July 2011: Maharashtra 11.9% behind Japan (NCP vs UN)

beats.say: Rajasthan, in north-west India, has about as many people as Germany.
And almost the same amount of land.
Twelve of the world's fifty biggest crowds, inside one country.
beats.cap: 12 of the top 50 · one country (2026, projected)
